svg.title: Storage authorities and data directory
svg.desc: Files under the data directory are canonical for sessions, memory workspaces and small stores; PostgreSQL holds authoritative task, workflow and knowledge records plus derived search tables that dartclaw rebuild-index regenerates. A standalone workflow run uses no database: execution.json stands in for the authoritative tables. Each store carries the badge of its recovery path.

g.text: Hover a store for what it holds and how it recovers; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Files hold canonical documents; PostgreSQL holds server records and rebuildable search projections.

g.text: STANDALONE · dartclaw workflow run --standalone · NO DATABASE
one directory per session, rewritten atomically
sessions/ · session record with nested conversationState, NDJSON transcript and attachments
meta.json is rewritten atomically under a per-file RepoLock; a deleted directory loses the session and leaves execution rows dangling.
workspace/ · memory corpus, wiki and behavior files per principal: owner, or agent:<id>
Only the Markdown corpus feeds memory_chunks; the wiki is read in place. Restore from the workspace .git or a file backup.
config, credentials, small stores · config, credentials, usage and audit logs, runtime-created projects, task artifact files
dartclaw.yaml is copied to .bak before each write; losing kv.json costs usage aggregates, usage.jsonl keeps the raw events.
instance-local state · active-turn recovery, webhook dedup, thread bindings, parked schedule changes, channel state
Missing or corrupt files start empty: turn_state.json is quarantined at open, bindings reconcile against active tasks and runs.
reproducible · git clones, task worktrees, shipped workflow definitions, container state, bridge binary, embedding model
Re-cloned, re-materialized or re-downloaded; built-in workflow definitions carry .dartclaw-managed.json fingerprints.
one row per chunk, scoped by user_id
memory_chunks · conversation_chunks · lexical search projections: text plus content_tsv with a GIN index, one row per chunk
After changing database.fts_language, restart and run dartclaw rebuild-index; stored rows keep the previous language until then.
pgvector, created only in hybrid mode
memory_vectors · conversation_vectors · pgvector rows keyed (user_id, document_id, chunk_index), ranked within one fingerprint and dimension
Created only after preflightVectorExtension proves pgvector; a partial projection refuses startup with reset-and-rebuild guidance.
no other copy; the schema gate validates them required-only
authoritative tables · tasks, executions, artifacts, goals, events, traces, runs, knowledge facts and the epoch marker; no other copy exists
PostgresSchemaGate refuses a mismatch with back-up-then-recreate guidance; no migration runner (workflow_run_migrations is inert).
execution.json · versioned checkpoint of standalone tasks, executions, runs, traces and events behind the same repository contracts
Published whole through atomicWriteJson under a RepoLock plus the OS lock; a malformed file refuses to load and is never reset.
isolated stores · sessions/, kv.json and turn_state.json under standalone/, separate from the server copies
A standalone run composes no knowledge graph and no search service; database histories are never copied in or out.
one executing process per data dir
execution.owner.lock · StandaloneExecutionLease holds it for the life of the process
Protects the per-process caches of the standalone session and KV services; status, pause and cancel skip the lease and use only the file lock.
